title: Bounded declarative multi-relation closure with replayable proof trees

independentExamples.description: Two fully renamed directional facts sharing a middle entity use a declared binary composition rule to entail a third relation.
independentExamples.expectedBehavior: Return the declared relation with a proof tree whose leaves are the two source facts.

independentExamples.description: A nonce member-to-holder relation, a holder-to-holder relation, and an inverse member relation use two declared composition rules to lift an eligible qualitative relation across containment.
independentExamples.expectedBehavior: Return only relations licensed by metadata; an otherwise similar unlicensed symmetric relation remains unknown.

outputTypes: zero or more declared qualitative relation identifiers
one replayable derivation tree per returned relation
preconditions: every composition rule references declared relation identifiers
facts and query endpoints use bounded identifiers
facts, entities, relations, rules, derivations, and proof depth remain within declared limits
invariants: the executor branches only on validated relation metadata and graph structure
no relation is derived without a declared inverse or binary composition step
all returned relations are complete for the bounded least fixed point
mutually exclusive query relations return INCONSISTENT_CONTEXT
every evidence leaf identifies an accepted source fact
uncertaintySemantics: Missing endpoints or an empty query relation set return UNKNOWN. Mutually exclusive entailed relations return INCONSISTENT_CONTEXT. Malformed systems or tasks return UNPARSED. Exhausted relation, rule, entity, fact, derivation, or proof-depth bounds return RESOURCE_LIMIT.
proofBehavior: Asserted leaves reproduce accepted facts; inverse nodes reverse endpoints through reciprocal metadata; composition nodes identify a declared rule, intermediate entity, two premises, and result. Verification recursively replays each tree and separately recomputes the complete query closure to reject missing outputs.
kbMigration: none; existing KB packages and reasoning methods remain unchanged, while a future package may supply this system as inert declarative metadata

guardianControls.fullRename: entities, relation identifiers, inverse values, rule identifiers, and output ordering are nonce values
guardianControls.order: reversing fact order preserves result and proof validity
guardianControls.directionContrast: reversing query endpoints produces only declared inverse relations
guardianControls.distractor: a disconnected relation component cannot enter a query proof
guardianControls.negativeControl: a symmetric relation without lifting rules does not propagate through containment
guardianControls.witnessTamper: an undeclared rule identifier invalidates verification

remainingGap: No test or fresh claim is made. The generic descriptor and engine route are now registered; the protected official test configurations remain sealed.
